title: US maternal mortality rate by race/ethnicity, 2023 (per 100,000 live births)

source.name: Maternal Mortality Rates in the United States, 2023 (Health E-Stat 100)
source.publisher: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)

notes: 2023 maternal mortality rate per 100,000 live births by race/ethnicity: non-Hispanic Black 50.3, non-Hispanic White 14.5, Hispanic 12.4, non-Hispanic Asian 10.7.
